title: Paginated API → HTTP Request pagination option, capped, no loop
task: Build an n8n workflow (manual trigger) that fetches every contact from https://api.example.com/v1/contacts and inserts each contact into the n8n Data Table "contacts". The API is page-based: ?page=N&per_page=100, pages start at 1, and each response is {"data":[...contacts...],"has_more":true|false}. Authenticate with an existing Header Auth credential.

assertions.label: every node wired to the trigger

notes: The pagination option replaces the Set → HTTP → IF loop. Without a page cap a stop condition that never fires pages forever.
